title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify. 
  Resolution Date : The date parliament elects the successor. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the person elected.
